ideas.title: Polymarket CLOB-vs-Spot Latency Scalper
ideas.summary: Polymarket UP/DOWN 5MIN contracts repriced ~100ms after BTC spot moves. Buy/sell the contract during the lag window when probability is mathematically stale.
ideas.edge: Pure mechanical latency — not predicting BTC, exploiting reprice delay.
ideas.scale_ceiling: Liquidity-bound; book depth typically caps a single fill at $5–15k notional.
red_team: Polymarket can patch the lag at any time — strategy goes to zero overnight.
API rate limits + 429 throttling under burst; need exponential backoff and pre-warmed connections.
US persons + Polymarket regulatory status — verify legality for the trading entity.
WebSocket disconnect during a streak = stuck inventory; need automatic flatten on disconnect.
Cross-venue clock skew can fake an edge; require NTP-synced timestamps and reject signals where t_polymarket - t_binance < 50ms.
Adversarial flow: other bots front-run our fills; need queue-position model.

ideas.title: Trump / Political Tweet Butterfly Cascade
ideas.summary: Stream political accounts (Trump, key Fed members, war-room handles). Classify content (war / tariff / Fed / company-specific). Map to a precomputed asset cascade (e.g., 'war mentioned' → +oil, +gold, +VIX, -SPY, -airlines, +defense).
ideas.edge: Sub-second reaction to high-signal headlines before retail keyboards move.
ideas.scale_ceiling: Limited by event frequency (a few high-quality signals per week).
red_team: Fake/deepfake tweets / hacked accounts → wrong trade. Verify via secondary source within 500ms or skip.
Many actors trade these accounts — edge is decaying fast; need <250ms execution.
Sarcasm/quote-tweets misclassified by LLM → wrong direction. Require ensemble agreement.
Halted symbols and limit-up/down → unable to flatten. Pre-screen for halt risk.
Regulatory: trading on someone's tweet is fine; trading on confidential leak isn't. Source must be public.
Account suspension / API outage. Need multi-source feed (X, Truth Social, news wire).

ideas.title: Cross-Venue Latency Arbitrage (Equities)
ideas.summary: Same equity priced microseconds apart across IEX/NASDAQ/ARCA. Detect dislocations > tick size + fees and rip the spread.
ideas.edge: Microstructure dislocation; classic stat-arb if co-located.
red_team: Without colocation we are 10-100ms late — pros eat us alive. Skip unless we add a sponsored access route.
Alpaca routing doesn't expose venue choice → cannot extract this edge through Alpaca alone.
Capital intensive; tiny edge per trade, requires huge volume to matter.
Reg NMS + ISO orders complexity.
ideas.rejection_reason: Not feasible via Alpaca retail API. Park unless we get a prime broker.

ideas.title: Earnings Implied-Move Drift
ideas.summary: When implied move >> historical actual move for a name, sell strangles into earnings + delta-hedge. When implied << actual, buy the cheap optionality.
ideas.edge: Vol risk premium / variance risk premium, well-documented persistent edge.
red_team: Tail-event risk: one earnings can wipe a year of gains. Need strict sizing + wing protection.
Alpaca options coverage limits (no multi-leg complex spreads in some accounts) — verify.
Borrow availability for short stock leg if needed.
Slippage on illiquid options chains.

ideas.title: Macro Regime Sector Rotation
ideas.summary: Classify regime weekly via FRED + market internals (yields, USD, breadth, VIX term). Long winning sectors / short losing sectors of the current regime.
ideas.edge: Diversified, low frequency, low blowup risk — the 'safety chassis' of the system.
red_team: Regime detection lag → wrong sector right at the inflection.
Sector ETF crowding and correlation breakdowns in stress.
Costs eaten by frequent rebalancing if regime flips often.

ideas.title: Multi-Factor Long/Short Equity
ideas.summary: Daily rank S&P 1500 by Momentum + Value + LowVol + Quality + Trend. Long top decile, short bottom decile, beta-neutral, rebalance weekly.
ideas.edge: Classic factor premia, time-tested. Designed to survive any single-factor failure.
red_team: Crowded trade — factor crashes (e.g., Aug 2007 quant quake).
Short borrow cost & locate failures on small caps.
PDT constraint: weekly rebalance keeps us within day-trade limit.
Survivorship bias in backtest; require point-in-time data.

ideas.title: VIX Term-Structure Carry
ideas.summary: When VIX futures curve is in contango, short front-month vol via VXX or short calls; when backwardated, flip long. Position-size by realized-vol z-score.
ideas.edge: Vol risk premium harvest with regime gate.
red_team: Tail blow-up risk (Feb 2018 'volmageddon'). Mandatory hard stop + far-OTM protection.
Requires options chain depth Alpaca may not support; verify.

ideas.title: Insider Form 4 / 13D Follow
ideas.summary: Parse SEC EDGAR Form 4 cluster-buys and 13D filings within minutes of publication; long names with significant insider purchases above $X notional.
red_team: Edge has compressed since 2010s; verify in current data.
Insider may be a dumb buyer (founder averaging down into bankruptcy).
Penny-stock noise — filter by min market cap + float.
